mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cm_mileage_statistic (id, company_id, department_id, department_name, plate_no, period_type, period_descr, statistic_date, work_hour, mileage, mileage1, mileage2, oil, oil1, oil2, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{record.id}, #{record.companyId}, #{record.departmentId}, #{record.departmentName}, #{record.plateNo}, #{record.periodType}, #{record.periodDescr}, #{record.statisticDate}, 0, #{record.mileage}, #{record.mileage1}, #{record.mileage2}, 0, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_id = new_row.company_id, department_id = new_row.department_id, department_name = new_row.department_name, mileage = new_row.mileage, mileage1 = new_row.mileage1, mileage2 = new_row.mileage2, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
